answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 20441 Country: Bangladesh Title: black cumin (kalo jira) is the best medicine for all disease except death. is it real hadith? Question: Assalamualikum, black cumin (kalo jira) is the best medicine for all disease except death. is it real hadith? Answer ID: 20441 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 495/425/B=1431) It is mentioned in hadith regarding nigella or black cumin that there is healing in black cumin for all diseases except death. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
